title: Account
subtitle: Export your data, or permanently delete your account.

theme.heading: Theme
theme.description: Switch between a light and dark look.

notifications.heading: Browser notifications
notifications.description: A heads-up when a vacancy step goes overdue or is due today, and a warning a few minutes before a calendar event starts.
notifications.unsupported: Notifications aren't supported in this browser.

digest.heading: Weekly email digest
digest.description: A weekly email with applications that have gone quiet, upcoming interviews, and your study streak.

telegram.heading: Telegram notifications
telegram.description: Get job-alert and weekly-digest notifications in Telegram, in addition to email.

export.heading: Export your data
export.description: Downloads a JSON file with your profile, vacancies, companies, and study progress — everything you've created in Zorya.

referrals.heading: Invite friends
referrals.description: Share your link — once a friend verifies their email and gets started, you earn bonus AI calls (capped per month).

deleteAccount.heading: Delete your account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently deletes your account and everything in it — vacancies, companies, CV, study progress. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmationSent: Check your email — click the link we sent to confirm the deletion. Nothing has been deleted yet.
deleteAccount.genericError: Couldn't start account deletion. Try again.
